summary: Practise HR AI fairness checks, risk mapping, and human-review controls. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Responsible AI in HR is the governance of AI-supported people decisions across their lifecycle. For HR practitioners, people analytics specialists, and leaders overseeing HR technology, the course develops skills to map decision workflows, check data quality and group outcomes, and define human-review and escalation controls. Exercises use synthetic HR datasets and include documenting risks and preparing an assurance report.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape, review, procure, or oversee AI-enabled decisions about applicants and employees. It is designed for people who need to assess evidence and turn fairness concerns into usable HR controls.
modules: HR Decision Inventory and NIST AI RMF
NIST AI RMF Monitoring and Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of HR processes such as recruitment, performance review, or workforce planning is expected. Basic spreadsheet skills are useful; no coding or programming is required. The fairness-analysis exercises use Excel and synthetic HR data.
